response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong general software engineering experience across 15+ years, there are critical skill gaps that make this a poor fit for the role. The position requires native-level Japanese language proficiency (not listed on resume), strong C programming expertise for UNIX systems (last C work ended in 2015), and specialized domain knowledge in embedded systems, networking security, and Linux kernel development. The candidate's recent 11 years of experience focus on web and backend development in TypeScript/Node.js with no demonstrated expertise in required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption) or networking protocols (SNMP, NETCONF, Layer-2/3 switching).
strengths: Extensive software development experience spanning 15+ years with proven ability to work on complex distributed systems and multiple programming languages
Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation demonstrated across multiple senior-level roles
General Linux familiarity and some experience with hardware development (robotics at Altom Consulting) showing potential foundational knowledge
concerns: Japanese language proficiency not mentioned; position requires native-level fluency as a hard requirement for collaboration and technical communication

Minimal recent C programming experience (last C/C++ role ended June 2015 and was only 6 months); 11 years of recent work in high-level languages (TypeScript, Node.js) unsuitable for embedded UNIX firmware development

No demonstrated experience in embedded networking, security technologies (encryption, authentication protocols, attack detection), or Linux kernel modification—core technical competencies required for this mid-senior level role
